segments.sn46.5:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami…pe… ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn46.5:1.6: Idha, bhikkhu, satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ…pe…
segments.sn46.5:1.7: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn46.5:1.8: Tassime satta bojjhaṅge bhāvayato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati, bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati, avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccati.
segments.sn46.5:1.10: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.

lines: Maggena asaṅkhataṃ nibbānaṃ, paccavekkhaṇāya katakiccataṃ, maggena vā kilesaniddāto pabujjhanatthāya, phalena pabujjhanabhāvatthāyātipi vuttaṃ hoti.
Bodhāyāti ettha bodho nāma bujjhanaṃ, taṃ pana kissa kenāti pucchanto “kiṃ bujjhanatthāyā”ti vatvā taṃ dassento “maggenā”tiādimāha.
Maggena nibbānaṃ bujjhanatthāya saṃvattanti, paccavekkhaṇāya katakiccataṃ bujjhanatthāya saṃvattanti, paṭhamavikappe sacchikiriyābhisamayo eva dassitoti tena atuṭṭhe “maggena vā”ti dutiyavikappamāha.
Vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitanti padehi sabbaṃ maggakiccaṃ tassa phalañca dassitaṃ.
